business_problem: To bypass the operational friction of stitching together multiple third-party software contracts, fragmented billing surfaces, and separate security frameworks, LAAM chose to build entirely cloud-native on Google Cloud from day one.
solution_summary: To bypass the operational friction of stitching together multiple third-party software contracts, fragmented billing surfaces, and separate security frameworks, LAAM chose to build entirely cloud-native on Google Cloud from day one. Key components include Firebase provides the application backend and mobile services that connect customer-facing experiences to the platform; Cloud Functions runs serverless or virtualized application services with elastic scale for production AI workloads; Cloud Armor adds governance, security, and control to the production AI and data environment; Cloud Monitoring observes application health, latency, and runtime behavior across the deployment; Google Maps Platform supplies location intelligence that is embedded into the user-facing workflow. Reported outcomes include Absorbs 50x volume spikes automatically with Cloud Run; Slashes order shipment timelines down to 168 minutes; Drives 78% customer adoption of conversational search using Gemini.

solution_components.role: Adds governance, security, and control to the production AI and data environment.

solution_components.name: Cloud Monitoring
solution_components.role: Observes application health, latency, and runtime behavior across the deployment.

solution_components.name: Google Maps Platform
solution_components.role: Supplies location intelligence that is embedded into the user-facing workflow.

solution_components.name: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
solution_components.role: Coordinates multi-agent workflows, tool calling, and governed automation across the application.

solution_components.name: Cloud SQL
solution_components.role: Stores transactional state and application data for the operational workflow at low latency.

solution_components.name: Cloud Storage
solution_components.role: Stores large files, lake data, or static assets that feed downstream analytics and applications.

solution_components.name: Pub/Sub
solution_components.role: Moves high-volume events and API traffic between services so the workflow stays decoupled and resilient.

solution_components.name: Cloud Run
solution_components.role: Runs serverless or virtualized application services with elastic scale for production AI workloads.
